submission.justification: Recommended Absorber-F1 with a 5.2 mm plate thickness because it gives the best observed 100 GeV electron energy resolution in the available Geant4 scans. The 2025 5 mm reference already showed F1 (3.2%) outperforming F2 (3.9%) and F3 (5.1%); the new scan found the F1 optimum in the ~5.0-5.3 mm region, with repeated 5.2 mm runs averaging about 3.18%, well below the best observed F2 (~3.8-4.0%) and F3 (~5.1%) values. Important caveat: the available project documents and tools do not provide residual dose-rate predictions or measurements, so the hard hands-on-maintenance activation requirement cannot be certified from the provided evidence; this recommendation is therefore the performance-optimal absorber choice contingent on activation verification before production approval.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Geant4 simulations show Absorber-F1 is the best-performing material. Around the optimum, F1 at 5.2 mm gave repeated results of 3.161%, 3.098%, and 3.294% at 100 GeV, averaging ~3.18%; the 2025 summary at 5 mm also reported F1 3.2%, better than F2 3.9% and F3 5.1%. New scans found best observed F2 values around 3.7-4.0% and F3 around 5.1%, both worse than F1.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F1, Absorber-F2, and Absorber-F3; the recommendation uses Absorber-F1.

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h for hands-on maintenance.
requirements.evidence: No residual dose-rate or activation data were present in the available project documents, and the available simulation tool reports only energy resolution. Therefore compliance with the <=20 uSv/h hard requirement cannot be verified from the provided evidence.
The recommended plate thickness is 5.2 mm, which lies within the allowed 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F1 at 5.2 mm.
